title: India's 2019 survey found a threefold gap in housework time
body: Among people aged 6 and over who did unpaid domestic work on the survey day, women and girls averaged 299 minutes and men and boys 97 minutes. India's National Statistical Office measured how people used their time in 2019.
takeaway: A time diary can reveal who bears the work of running a household, even when nobody receives a wage.
source: National Statistical Office, Time Use in India (2019)

title: Some of Jeju's free divers work into their eighties
body: On South Korea's Jeju Island, the haenyeo gather shellfish by diving without a breathing apparatus, sometimes to about 10 metres. UNESCO's 2016 listing describes a community that includes women in their eighties.
takeaway: Experienced divers pass on knowledge of local waters, making a livelihood a way to teach the next generation.
source: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, Culture of Jeju Haenyeo (2016)
